p.em: writes descend through the WAL before publishing · reads traverse only the overlay

g.text: ② Lock-free overlay — core/overlay/ (the LIVE representation)
③ WAL + durability — core/wal/ · core/durability.rs · core/committed_watermark.rs
⑥ Arena · block storage — core/{arena_slot · block_storage · swizzled_ptr}.rs

div.p: Color key · 🟩 green = lock-free overlay (live, in-memory) · 🟨 amber = durability control (WAL append+fsync · watermark) · 🟦 blue = disk-backed (WAL store · disk manager · arena) · ⬜ grey = infrastructure (buffer manager · dirty tracker)
